papers.title_en: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Gain Tuning in Control of Teleoperation Manipulators with Joint Flexibility and Time-Varying Delays
papers.authors: Armin Attarzadeh, Mohammad Ali Ghaemifar, Alireza Khanzadeh, Soheil Ganjefar
papers.evidence: 深度强化学习用于遥操作机械臂控制
papers.tldr: 遥操作系统中关节柔性和时变延迟导致主从机器人不稳定。提出混合控制方法，将P+d控制器与TD3强化学习结合：P+d保证有界延迟下基本稳定，TD3智能体实时调节远程侧比例和阻尼增益以抑制振动并提升跟踪精度。Lyapunov-Krasovskii分析确保稳定性。该方法为实际柔性关节遥操作系统的自适应增益调节提供了有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: Bilateral teleoperation systems that include joint flexibility better reflect real robotic systems used in surgery, space, and rehabilitation. However, joint flexibility together with time-varying communication delays makes it difficult to maintain stable and coordinated motion between the master and slave robots. To address this, we propose a hybrid control method that combines a stable Proportional-plus-Damping (P+d) controller with a model-free deep reinforcement learning agent based on the Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3) algorithm. The P+d controller provides basic stability under bounded delays, while the learning agent adjusts and tunes the remote-side proportional and damping gains in real time to reduce vibrations and improve tracking. Stability is guaranteed for bounded time-varying delays using Lyapunov-Krasovskii analysis. The approach provides a practical solution for teleoperation systems facing both joint flexibility and uncertain network delays.

papers.title_en: Information-Based Exploration via Random Features for Reinforcement Learning
papers.evidence: 通用的强化学习探索方法，可应用于机械臂控制
papers.tldr: 深度强化学习中表示学习虽扩展了经典探索策略，却增加了算法复杂度和理论保证难度。本文提出基于随机傅里叶特征的信息增益(RFIG)，从贝叶斯核方法出发，在非可数状态空间中高效近似信息增益作为探索奖励，并推导出近似误差上界，避免了神经网络不确定性估计的黑箱问题。该方法可平滑集成至标准深度RL算法，实验表明在多种控制与导航任务中与主流深度探索方法性能相当，同时具备更优的理论可解释性。
papers.abstract_en: Representation learning has enabled classical exploration strategies to be extended to deep Reinforcement Learning (RL), but often makes algorithms more complex and theoretical guarantees harder to establish. We introduce Random Feature Information Gain (RFIG), grounded in Bayesian kernel methods theory, which uses random Fourier features to approximate information gain and compute exploration bonuses in non-countable spaces. We provide error bounds on information gain approximation and avoid the black-box aspects of neural network-based uncertainty estimation, for optimism-based exploration. We present practical details that make RFIG scalable to deep RL scenarios, enabling smooth integration into standard deep RL algorithms. Experimental evaluation across diverse control and navigation tasks demonstrates that RFIG achieves competitive performance with well-established deep exploration methods while offering superior theoretical interpretation.

papers.title_en: Disturbance-Aware Flight for Aerial Robots in Narrow Space
papers.authors: Lei Qiang, Tianyu He, Chenyang Sun, Xurui Liu, Miao Wang, Xiaobin Zhou
papers.evidence: 空中机器人动力学与扰动感知控制，可迁移至空中机械臂系统
papers.tldr: 四旋翼在狭窄空间飞行面临强气动扰动和有限空间的双重挑战。现有规划仅依赖几何约束和固定速度，未融合扰动信息，导致行为保守或危险。本文提出扰动感知规划控制框架DAPCF，通过双环观测器实时估计6自由度扰动力，引入扰动风险函数自适应调节参考速度，并设计基于电机动力学的非线性模型预测控制器进行补偿。实验表明，0.39米对角的四旋翼可成功穿越0.6米狭窄隧道，在成功率和效率上均超越人类飞行员。该工作将扰动估计融入规划控制环路，显著提升了狭窄空间自主飞行的安全性与敏捷性。
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous flight of aerial robots in narrow space remains challenging due to strong aerodynamic disturbances and limited flying space. Existing approaches mainly address aerodynamic disturbances at the control level, while motion planning typically relies on geometric constraints and fixed speed limits, leading to conservative or unsafe behaviors in confined environments. This paper presents a disturbance-aware planning and control framework (DAPCF) that integrates online disturbance estimation into the planning-control loop for quadrotor flight in narrow space. First, the dual-loop observers estimate 6-degree-of-freedom disturbance forces and torques in real time based on odometry and motor speed measurements. Then, a disturbance risk function is introduced that adaptively modulates the reference speed of the planner based on disturbance estimation, reducing velocity when disturbances exceed a threshold and restoring it under low-disturbance conditions. Finally, a motor-dynamics-based nonlinear model predictive controller (MDNMPC) with disturbance compensation is designed to ensure robust trajectory tracking under perturbed conditions. Experiments demonstrate that a quadrotor with a diagonal length of 0.39~m can traverse straight, sloped, and curved tunnels as narrow as 0.6~m, outperforming human pilots in both success rate and flight efficiency.
